channel.title: Food Safety Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Food Safety Magazine (food-safety.com)

item.title: Food Safety Summit Offers Cert Courses Covering Preventive Controls, AI, Food Fraud, HACCP, and Allergens
item.description: The robust lineup of Certificate Courses offers in-depth, practical training led by internationally recognized experts.

item.title: Assessing Food Safety Competence: Meeting Certification Expectations through On-Floor Capability Building
item.description: Proposed certification scheme updates, such as SQF Edition 10 and ISO 9001:2026, are shifting the focus from compliance to proactive, integrated food safety management. For quality assurance teams, this represents both a challenge and an opportunity: ensuring safe, compliant operations while influencing broader operational performance and workforce capability.

item.title: U.S. CDC Supports Moldova’s First Use of WGS in Foodborne Illness Outbreak Investigation
item.description: Marking the country’s first use of whole genome sequencing (WGS) in an active foodborne illness outbreak investigation, advanced genomics enabled Moldovan authorities to rapidly solve and respond to a salmonellosis outbreak that sickened more than 140 people in 2025.

item.title: FDA to Replace Human Foods Complaint System with New Dashboard for All Regulated Products
item.description: By the end of May, complaint systems for all FDA-regulated products, including human and animal foods, will be replaced by the new, streamlined Adverse Event Monitoring System (AEMS).

item.title: Study Suggests Potential of Low-Moisture Antimicrobial for Dry Food Facilities
item.description: Researchers have developed and validated a rapidly vaporizing antimicrobial liquid designed for dry sanitization, which, after further optimization and regulatory approvals, could offer a potential alternative to highly flammable alcohol-based solutions.

item.title: Congressional Bill Would Direct FDA to Enforce Stronger Infant Formula Safety Oversight
item.description: The Infant Formula Safety Modernization Act includes provisions about expanded pathogen testing requirements and compulsory environmental monitoring for infant formula manufacturers, among other mandates.

item.title: New FDA Risk Assessment Informs FSMA Requirements for Raw Manure Use on Produce
item.description: Providing evidence for potential Produce Safety Rule standards, the assessment examined how pathogens survive in untreated biological soil amendments of animal origin (BSAAO) and contaminate produce. FDA found that longer time between BSAAO application and harvest significantly reduces crop contamination.

item.title: Key Technology Introduces COMPASS Optical Sorter for Vegetable Processing
item.description: The system was developed for vegetable processors handling multiple SKUs, mixed products, and frequent production changeovers. COMPASS is ideal for fresh and individually quick frozen (IQF) corn, peas, and green beans.

item.title: Revisiting the Safety of Fresh Produce from Field to Fork
item.description: This article examines the frequent contamination of fresh produce (e.g., cucumber and sprouts due to recent outbreaks linked to these foods) with Salmonella and Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli.

item.title: Researchers Develop Colorimetric Sensor that Allows Naked-Eye E. coli Detection in Food
item.description: The platform uses a DNAzyme-crosslinked hydrogel that produces a visible color change when E. coli is present, enabling equipment-free, point-of-use detection. It successfully detected E. coli in a range of foods, even when other pathogens were present.
